exceptions.title: Buffer Overflow via toBigIntLE() Function
exceptions.rationale: Reviewed 2026-08-21: no patched bigint-buffer version or upstream Solana dependency path exists, and the vulnerable APIs are not called directly by application code.
exceptions.reason: GitHub still reports every bigint-buffer version through 1.1.5 as affected with no patched release. bigint-buffer remains a transitive Solana SDK dependency: the installed @solana/spl-token@0.4.14 chain uses @solana/buffer-layout-utils@0.2.0, while the current @solana/spl-token@0.4.15 release moves to @solana/buffer-layout-utils@^0.3.0 whose latest 0.3.0 release still requires bigint-buffer@^1.1.5. The vulnerable toBigIntLE() API is not called directly in this codebase. Exploitation can crash the process (DoS, not RCE); the reachable SPL Token codecs pass fixed-width protocol fields, including eight-byte u64 slices, rather than arbitrary attacker-sized buffers.
exceptions.mitigation: Application code never calls bigint-buffer directly. Reachable SPL Token codecs constrain bigint decoding to fixed-width protocol fields, including eight-byte u64 slices; CI retains the advisory and enforces another review within 90 days.
mitigations: CVE ignored via pnpm.auditConfig.ignoreCves in package.json
Security audit added to CI pipeline to catch new vulnerabilities
No direct usage of bigint-buffer APIs in application code
